features.title: Tab strip scrolls horizontally with a hidden scrollbar
features.trigger: Scroll horizontally (wheel or trackpad) when tabs overflow
features.context: Many lists in one project
features.result: The strip scrolls sideways when tabs overflow; no scrollbar is shown.
sources: ListTabs.tsx:95-97 (overflow-x-auto [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden). The strip class matches the spec.
No reference has overflowing tabs (no many-lists project; all trees show at most three tabs) and no scroll gesture. overflow-x-auto and the hidden scrollbar class are not visible.
edge_cases: The scrollbar is hidden only through the ::-webkit-scrollbar selector, so engines without that pseudo-element would still show a scrollbar. The target is WebKit (macOS), so this is a caveat only.
No wheel handler is present in ListTabs.tsx; a vertical wheel does not scroll the strip sideways unless the input device sends horizontal deltas.
